preconditions.description: The input must be either a string or an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output string is either lowercase or a digit.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str(input) if not isinstance(input, str) else True
postconditions.description: If the input is not a string (e.g., an integer), the output is the string representation of the input.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.startswith(c.lower()) for c in input if c.isupper()) or not any(c.isupper() for c in input)
postconditions.description: For each uppercase letter in the input string, the output string starts with the lowercase version of that letter followed by an underscore, except for the first character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == input.lower() if not any(c.isupper() for c in input) else True
postconditions.description: If the input string contains no uppercase letters, the output is the lowercase version of the input string.
The output string, with underscores removed, is equal to the lowercase version of the input string.
